# Review — kebra-nagast-ch61 (ch. 61)

Two passes. Dillmann was not available; every lexical call below is hedged with (?) rather than invented. No modern translation was opened. The Geʿez (`t`) of all 35 units joins exactly to the packet, every unit ends at ። ፤ or ፨, and the `p` flags (unit 0 the heading, unit 1 the single paragraph) are right; no unit exceeds 45 words. Nothing in `t` or `p` was changed.

## Findings refused (with reason)

- Unit 3 · መላህቅት rendered 'the elders' (the same English as አእሩግ in unit 1). Refused: the published entry ልሂቅ / መላህቅት reads 'elders, great ones'; consistency with it outweighs the repeated word. The (?) in l and the note stay.
- Unit 4 · ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ 'before they asked' vs the published 'without' + jussive. Refused as a change to the unit (the context, 1 Samuel 4 before 1 Samuel 8, requires 'before'); instead the reading was added to __broaden__ with (?).
- Unit 19 · the 'stray ኣ' of ወበጽሐአ in the note. Kept: a 3fp perfect would be በጽሓ, so the extra አ is plausibly a slip; the gloss already calls the form 3fp.
- Unit 21 · ወለእሙንቱሰ ... ሠፀርዎን: the masculine ለእሙንቱ does not match the fem. -ዎን, and the sense of ሠፀረ is not established. Left as the drafter had it (hedged in l, i, note and gloss); I could not improve it without Dillmann (?).
- Unit 30 · i 'Later' for ካዕበ (l has 'And-again'). Kept: it is a fair paraphrase that links the Ark's moves, and the force is the same.
- Units 6, 12, 13, 16 · the nesting of quotation marks (a speech inside the counsellors' speech, which begins at unit 3 and runs to the end of the chapter). Kept local to each unit, as in the published parts; only the stray re-opening quote at unit 11 was removed. The nesting could be made fully consistent in one later sweep across parts.
- Unit 16 · ይርሐኑ 'load/hitch' and ተግሒሦሙ stem, unit 15 · ይሰዳ, unit 12 · ጠዪቀክሙ, unit 25 · እንተ ትንእስ በትር 'smallest rod': readings stay as the drafter hedged them; no better reading could be established without Dillmann. The እንተ entry was not broadened for unit 25: the published entry (which, who, fem.) already covers a fem. relative.
- Unit 29 · ኢበመሥዋዕት ወኢበዕጣን 'without sacrifice or incense': kept (the note already hedges whose action is negated).
- Gloss · ሰገል/መሰግል: the singular lemma መሰግል for መሰግላን was kept (hedged (?)); the form is an agent noun in መ- on the evidence of the plural only.
- Gloss · ፄወወ root 'ṣ-w-w', ወሕበጥ/ሕበጥ and other root letters in the glosses: not changed; no authority to correct them.
- Gloss · the published (known) entry for እክል has the lemma ክህለ 'I can' (a wrong lemma for the noun 'grain'). The ch. 61 __broaden__ keeps the old entry whole as the rules require and adds 'grain'; a shared-glossary fix is needed later (outside this part's scope).
